submittedProject.oneLinePitch: ProofEra helps users hire BNB Chain DeFi agents through verifiable evidence, bounded authority, and receipt-backed revocation - not promises.
submittedProject.projectDescription: ProofEra is an evidence-first marketplace for BNB Chain DeFi agents: users hire by financial job, not by agent descriptions or popularity. It gives LP, grid, yield, and health-monitoring agents category-specific passports showing sources, freshness, costs, downside, permissions, receipts, and explicit unknowns. ERC-8004 identity is treated as identity-not performance proof. Before capital access, ProofEra bounds chain, target, selector, token, spend cap, and expiry; afterward, users can inspect receipts and verify revocation. We optimized for a simple discover-to-understand-to-activate journey, read-only analysis before capital, fail-closed integrations, and honest evidence. Missing, stale, testnet, and unverified data remain visible instead of becoming a score or marketing claim.

limitations: The owner supplied the rendered Google Forms response-receipt text in the interactive project session; original email bytes, headers and an edit-response link are not retained.
Personal identity, contact, location, experience, payout-wallet and opaque Additional Notes values are intentionally omitted from repository evidence.

The response receipt supports the bounded claim that a ProofEra entry was submitted through the official linked form; it does not prove organizer acceptance, eligibility, judging outcome or prize status.
The submitted Additional Notes did not include the demo or evidence links. Public recovery links are retained separately and a Telegram correction is recommended.
